title: PaymentAdjusted
description: A haul's sum was settled again after its card payment was charged. A lower sum went back to the shipper's wallet (`delta` negative); a higher one was charged to the card (`delta` positive, what the card gave of it). `captured`, `refunded` and `shortfall` are the payment's totals after it.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payment_id.description: The card payment of the load.

load_id.description: The load the payment is for.

load_code.description: The load's short code, for example `GW-7F3K2M`; null when billing was not told it.

authorized.description: What stands blocked on the card for the load, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

carrier_org_id.description: The carrier organization of the haul.

adjustment_id.description: What tells this adjustment from another of the same payment.

delta.description: What the shipper paid more (positive) or got back (negative), whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

commission_delta.description: How the platform's commission on the haul moved with it, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

captured.description: Taken from the card in all, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

refunded.description: Given back in all, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

shortfall.description: What the card did not give in all, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).
